fields.title: CI fails on a new high advisory, not on the reviewed ones
fields.description: Replace `npm audit --audit-level=high` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with `scripts/ci/audit-gate.mjs`. It fails on any high or critical advisory not in `.github/audit-allowlist.json`, or past its review-by date. It also fixes the new follow-redirects advisories.
fields.notes: Created 2026-10-22 by Blurby.Roadmap on Blurby.Brain's ruling (Rule 11 tier 1), from blurby-6b's ELECTRON-42-UPGRADE-1 finding: the CI audit step already fails on main. Not a release gate (no workflow builds installers). After ELECTRON-42-UPGRADE-1 (same ci.yml and lockfile). Full Spec: U9/U10 pass.
